paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Polarity scores for Indonesia
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the distribution of polarity scores for Indonesia, showing the frequency of different sentiment scores. The x-axis represents the polarity scores, with a linear scale, ranging from -1.1 to 0.6, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis represents the counts, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 35000, and tick labels at intervals of 5000. A single blue line with circular markers is shown, representing the count of polarity scores; it starts at a count of 261 for a polarity score of -1.05, remains relatively stable until a score of -0.6, where it begins to rise, reaching a peak count of 35807 at a score of 0.05, followed by a decline to 142 at a score of 0.55; notable intermediate counts include 2500 at a score of -0.45, 5000 at a score of -0.25, 17242 at a score of 0.15, and 6929 at a score of 0.45.
